At the office, Murdock was discussing work with Kirsten McDuffie when Angela Del Toro arrived to meet with him.
Murdock woke up in a hospital bed in Metro-General Hospital.
With Wilson Fisk gone and ousted as mayor, New York began returning to normal.
The next morning, Murdock awoke in his wrecked apartment and went to work.
Karen Page arrived the next morning to check on Murdock, believing him to have been in a car accident.

Later, Murdock, Foggy Nelson and Karen Page went to Josie's Bar where they shot pool.
Graduating from Xavier High School, Murdock was accepted to Columbia University and received a dorm on campus.
Once Murdock stepped into his apartment, he got himself a drink and smiled thinking about his kiss with Karen Page.
Later in the Yakatomi Building parking lot, Daredevil located Stan Gibson, taking out his bodyguards.
With the threat of the Hand seemingly dealt with for the time being, Murdock and Stick visited Elektra 's grave.
